title: SLOW!
text: SLOW!. It's the first time i ever bought one but it seems it took too long to cook hot dogs!  It took 15-20 minutes to cook and i remember my neighbor cooked us hot dogs on her older model and it only took 8-10 minutes!  I'm not that crazy about it
